name: Charter Spikeback
description: Gather weight low and hold the haft close so the next descent comes from a settled base.

name: Lambasting Eyehole
description: Carry the head over the shoulder and let it fall onto the foe's guarding arm.

name: Might Hammerface
description: Plant the heel hard on each step so the stride adds its weight to the swinging hammer.

name: Toxin Forge
description: Hook the beak over a raised guard and pull down so the arm drops into the next blow.

name: Peenside Assault
description: Sink the body and send qi down the haft so the head lands as if it weighed twice as much.

name: Facetpeen
description: Drop the spike through the gap beside a raised guard and crack the arm that braces it.

name: Peenbarrage
description: Bring the head down with full qi so the ground heaves and every foe near the point staggers.

name: Gyve Faceplate
description: Press the head onto the foe's weapon arm and hold it down with steady qi so it cannot rise.

name: Thorn Anvilback
description: Hold the hammer low and angled while the eyes search the opponent's plate for a fault.

name: Mightforge
description: Tap along the plate edges with the face to find a loose seam by its sound.

name: Tampcuirass
description: Hook the beak onto the shoulder plate and tug to open the armpit to a following blow.

name: Torrent Clawside
description: Step to the side where the plate overlap is weakest and set the head to strike.

name: Ravaging Cheekplate
description: Strike the fault with qi in the face so the plate dents deeply along its seam.

name: Facet Anvilfall
description: Set the spike on the fault line of the cuirass and drive qi through to the body beneath.

name: Tampgreave
description: Hook the beak under a split plate and tear it away to leave the flesh bare.

name: Skinning Peenbite
description: Pound one seam in a steady qi-fed rhythm until the whole plate comes apart and falls away.

name: Rumble Drivehome
description: Heave the hammer overhead and drop it with full qi so a plate bursts outward in pieces.

name: Resilient Hammerneck
description: Stand firm in a packed line with the haft crosswise to hold off the press of bodies.

name: Splintering Beakpick
description: Rap the nearest foe with the short haft end while the shoulders stay locked with a comrade.

name: Paralyzing Hammerneck
description: Shove with the haft and elbow together to open a gap in the press of men.

name: Soaring Hammerblow
description: Take short sliding paces between bodies so the hammer never loses its footing.

name: Anvilcloak
description: Parry a thrust from the second rank with the low haft while the head stays raised.

name: Splitting Cheekplate
description: Swing the hammer in a flat circle with qi so everyone around is knocked back a pace.

name: Gyveforge
description: Pin a seized arm against a shield with the haft and hold it with qi while the head strikes.

name: Granite Tamp
description: Crush a foe with a short hard blow driven from the hips where the press leaves no room to swing.

name: Needling Spikeback
description: Lean on a foe's guard with haft and head and pour qi forward until the whole front gives way.

name: Mayhemanvil
description: Slam the hammer down and loose a burst of qi that throws the surrounding press off its feet.

name: Aegisanvil
description: Close both hands on the haft so the first thread of qi runs through the wood.

name: Furrowing Hammerblow
description: Tap the target lightly with the head to learn how far the living haft truly reaches.

name: Chime Peenside
description: Bend the haft with a thread of qi so the beak hooks round a raised shield rim.

name: Torrent Anvilfall
description: Take one long pace that sets the foe just inside the stretched reach of the hammer.

name: Mightsmith
description: Let qi lengthen the haft by a hand so the head lands where the foe thought himself safe.

name: Beakpick Cuirass
description: Let the qi-filled haft yield under a cut and turn it aside along the curve of the wood.

name: Peenthrash
description: Take the shock of one blow into the haft and release it all in a rebounding strike back.

name: Unflinching Hammerface
description: Bend the qi-filled haft under a heavy blow and let it spring so the force returns to its source.

name: Facetanvil
description: Stand with the hammer head held before the chest so that any blow against it rings and tells the foe's strength.

name: Iron Faceplate
description: Tap the face on the foe's armor and listen to its note to learn how thick the steel is.

name: Drubbing Clawside
description: Rap three places on a plate until the note that rings falsest shows its weakest spot.

name: Anvilthrash
description: Knock the heavy part of the face against the breastplate to make a low note that numbs.

name: Chimeanvil
description: Grip the haft so the ring of an enemy blow dies in the hands and the hammer turns it.

name: Soaring Anvilback
description: Step on the beat of the last note so the next blow arrives while the steel still shivers.

name: Gustforge
description: Beat the plate with growing qi so each blow rings higher and loosens the armor more.

name: Forge Torment
description: Strike at the false note of a plate with qi in the spike so the metal cracks through.

name: Smithgreave
description: Strike the helm so the ringing blurs the wearer's hearing and sense of direction.

name: Downpour Eyehole
description: Ring the head with a pulse of qi so a field of shaking sound rattles every armored foe near.

name: Cleaving Peenbite
description: Drop the head on the exact note of a plate so the steel shatters from within.

name: Aegis Hammerface
description: Stand with both faces of the double head ready so either end can answer a blow.

name: Iron Drivehome
description: Tap the foe with one face and at once with its twin to set a paired rhythm.

name: Chimepeen
description: Turn the haft to bring the second face onto the arm the first face has pushed aside.

name: Whipping Hammerblow
description: Take two matched steps so the paired blows land in time with the feet.

name: Grinding Tamp
description: Land one blow with the face and its twin with the poll in a single qi-fed paired beat.

name: Torrent Faceplate
description: Turn aside a cut with the first face and sweep the second face across the attacker's wrist.

name: Tempered Peenside
description: Drop both faces in two falling arcs a heartbeat apart so the second lands on the dented first.

name: Anvilfall Barrage
description: Drive the first face to stagger the plate and the twin spike into the gap it opens.

name: Charter Hammerneck
description: Plant the feet wide as if in a ford and hold the buckler forward with the hammer behind.

name: Anvilcuirass
description: Shove with the buckler edge against a foe pressing in like a current and turn him aside.

name: Rumble Eyehole
description: Tap the hammer across the front of the foe's guard while the buckler holds his weapon down.

name: Might Clawside
description: Step along the line of the buckler edge like a walker keeping to the river bank.

name: Rumbletamp
description: Drop the hammer from behind the buckler with qi so it lands like a stone falling into water.

name: Murkanvil
description: Meet a cut with a circling buckler and hammer so the force spins away in an eddy.

name: Paralyzing Spikeback
description: Hook the beak behind a shield or knee and draw it downstream so the foe loses his footing.

name: Splintering Cheekplate
description: Press forward behind buckler and hammer with steady qi so the opposing line cannot cross the ground.

name: Forge Thrash
description: Slam the hammer low and loose a surge of qi that sweeps nearby foes off their feet like a flood.

name: Charter Beakpick
description: Hold the hammer high and still like a hawk on a perch and watch for the opening.

name: Iron Tamp
description: Jab the beak forward like a talon at the gap between helm and collar.

name: Torrent Hammerface
description: Circle wide then cut in sharply so the hammer arrives from the foe's blind side.

name: Fortifying Hammerneck
description: Hold still and read the foe's weight and guard before beginning the fall of the hammer.

name: Wrecking Cheekplate
description: Tap the foe's guard so lightly that it draws his weapon out of line without a clash.

name: Murkpeen
description: Hold the haft hovering above the head so a cut glances off it and away.

name: Rupturing Peenbite
description: Drop from a high guard with qi in the head so the hammer lands with the speed of a stoop.

name: Toxin Anvilback
description: Sink the beak into a collar plate like a talon and pull the foe off balance.

name: Facet Faceplate
description: Dive the spike downward into the gap of a bent opponent with qi riding behind it.

name: Silt Drivehome
description: Sweep the hammer in two wide beats like wings so nearby foes are driven back from each side.

name: Granite Eyehole
description: Leap and fall upon the foe with the full weight and qi of the hammer in a single dreadful stoop.

name: Grinding Nova Peenbite
description: Drive the beak down from above through the thickest plate with qi packed into its point.

name: Annealed Peenside
description: Stand with body force and qi each held on its own track before the haft.

name: Harrowing Anvilback
description: Tap with strength of the body alone to test the guard before the qi track joins.

name: Smithtorment
description: Rap with qi alone through a loose arm to meet the body track blow with its pair.

name: Soaring Spikeback
description: Take a slow step and let force gather in the legs like water rising in a basin.

name: Iron Hammerblow
description: Land body force and qi on the same instant so both tracks meet in the face of the hammer.

name: Splitting Drivehome
description: Press steadily on a guard while force builds in the haft until the guard sags and gives.

name: Tempered Anvilfall
description: Let the filled basin overflow into one blow that carries both tracks of force into the target.

name: Glint Clawside
description: Meet the body track and the qi track at the spike so they pierce plate as joined rivers.

name: Granite Hammerface
description: Turn the shoulders to the foe and take a fixed bearing with the hammer held along that line.

name: Peentorment
description: Strike straight along the sworn bearing so the blow cannot stray from the mark.

name: Chime Forge
description: Hook the beak along the held bearing to pull a foe's weapon off his own line.

name: Torrent Eyehole
description: Move along the edge of the foe's reach as a rider keeps to the plateau rim.

name: Staunch Beakpick
description: Hold the haft across the bearing to turn a cut aside without losing the line.

name: Severing Hammerneck
description: Send qi down the held bearing so the hammer lands exactly on the spot first marked.

name: Enduring Clawside
description: Keep the bearing unbroken while the haft turns the cut with qi at the point of contact.

name: Gust Cheekplate
description: Lock the stance on its bearing and crush through the guard with a straight qi-fed blow.

name: Gust Drivehome
description: Fall upon the foe along the sworn bearing with all of the stance and qi in one blow.

name: Paralyzing Gyve Beakpick
description: Press the head against the foe along the bearing and hold with qi so he cannot slip the line.

name: Granite Spikeback
description: Stand open to the wind with the hammer low and let it push against the haft.

name: Rumble Anvilback
description: Swing with the wind at the back so the head carries more speed into the foe.

name: Chime Anvilfall
description: Hook the beak into a gust at the rim of the foe's shield and tear the shield aside.

name: Blurring Peenside
description: Rise on the ball of the foot as an updraft lifts the hammer for a falling blow.

name: Blaze Forge
description: Let a pulse of qi gather the wind and carry the head into the foe with extra weight.

name: Chime Faceplate
description: Ride the force of a blow with the haft as wind rides over the plateau and cast it off.

name: Mightanvil
description: Crush down with qi and the heavy wind at the back so a shield or helm gives way.

name: Lancing Hammerblow
description: Bring the hammer down with gale-driven qi so the blow throws dust and nearby foes outward.

name: Hollowforge
description: Spin the head with wind behind it so the spike shears cleanly through a plate edge.

name: Aegis Beakpick
description: Hold the haft along the line the wind runs so the hammer rests easy against the gusts.

name: Ironsmith
description: Tap along the gale line with a swing that rides the wind and wastes no strength.

name: Compressing Peenside
description: Turn the haft with the wind so the beak catches a weapon and drags it off line.

name: Gust Anvilback
description: Pace along the gale line with the wind at the heels so the hammer stays level.

name: Granite Forge
description: Send qi along the gale line so the head and the wind arrive at the foe together.

name: Facet Clawside
description: Hold the haft braced against the wind with qi so a heavy blow cannot push it down.

name: Eyehole Barrage
description: Sweep the hammer along the whole gale line so that foes caught along it are thrown back.

name: Glamour Hammerneck
description: Wrap the haft in a swirl of wind and qi so a heavy blow is turned back upon its source.

name: Hoarfrost Faceplate
description: Stand angled into the crosswind with the hammer low and the weight on both feet.

name: Fortifying Cheekplate
description: Pause to feel which way the gust leans before choosing the angle of the swing.

name: Lambasting Hammerface
description: Bend the swing against the gust so the tap lands on the foe's near hand.

name: Might Drivehome
description: Step to the lee side of the foe where the wind will not slow the hammer.

name: Chimesmith
description: Turn the haft with the crosswind so a thrust is carried past the body.

name: Blazepeen
description: Bend the arc of the hammer round a gust with qi so it curves past a raised guard.

name: Toxintamp
description: Hook the beak at the lee of a shield and pull it round to open the foe's flank.

name: Ravaging Tamp
description: Strike with a squall of qi in the haft so the blow lands in a sudden hard press.

name: Spikeback Assault
description: Pound the ground and air in turn with the shifting wind so foes on all sides are battered.

name: Rumbleanvil
description: Drop the hammer straight into the headwind so the qi in the head breaks through the shield.
